title: "Library"
---

## Contact

- `bibliothek@fs.de` (central contact address)

## Ordering

- Order personal reserve collections by email.
- Case study orders are handled through the library; program managers must be involved.

## Search and Access

[Library databases and services](https://fsggmbh.sharepoint.com/sites/Library):

  - OPAC
  - Discovery services

- OpenAthens replaces VPN access for off-campus use and must be accessed through the discovery service infrastructure.
- Factual databases are provided separately, for example Bloomberg and Wharton Research Data Services.
- E-books must be installed on devices by the IT Department.

## Publishing

- Forward information about new publications to the department assistant.
  Full author names are important for cataloguing.
- Jonathan Marks plans to establish an internal FS case study collection.
- Open-access publishing is supported.
  FS has transformative agreements with most publishers.
  Otherwise, funding from central resources may be available.

FS has transformative agreements with:

- Springer
- Wiley
- Elsevier
- SAGE
- Taylor & Francis
